title: SharePoint: find information and get answers from Lists in Knowledge Agent
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents Restricted Content Discovery as a way to govern site availability, but does not establish the briefing's claim that a tenant administrator must use it to achieve a uniform position. The listed commands and paths are otherwise supported; two checklist controls are missing from the table, and another Microsoft page uses a different label for the discovery setting.
